Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G5057; a tax-gatherer's place of business:--receipt of custom.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the receipt of custom, the tax office where the collector sat. Jesus saw Matthew sitting at the receipt of custom and said, Follow Me; and he arose and followed Him, leaving all.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the tax office is where Jesus found an apostle, and the call came in the middle of the day's work.
